name: Egawa Yuko
source:
A member of the School's PC Club, alongside Kenji, who is known for her kind and cheerful attitude. She has walked with a crutch for most of her life.

[spoiler]She moonlights as a prostitute named "Rumi" due to having low self-esteem from needing a crutch, and also secretly feels jealous of other kids who don't need one.[/spoiler]
